post.description:
IEA country name to ISO3 crosswalk (from api.iea.org/countries) with aggregates flagged: World, OECD Total/Europe/Americas/Asia Oceania, IEA Total, EU27, Africa, Asia, China including Hong Kong, Eurasia. post.description:
Observations from one free IEA dataset for the given countries (ISO3 or IEA names, required, up to 50), optionally filtered by products, flows (balance flows or price sectors), indicators (data-browser indicators such as TFCbySource, ElecGenByFuel, CO2BySector) and year range; paged with an opaque cursor over a deterministic ordering. Values are decimal strings with the source unit; null values stay null. Paid and non-CC dataset ids fail with license_restricted and the product/purchase page.

<!-- aisa-pricing:start -->
Usage-based billing; Default request estimate: $0.0005 USD (not a fixed price). Account-specific pricing and final settlement may differ.
<!-- aisa-pricing:end -->

countries.description: Required in practice: ISO3 codes (FRA), ISO2, IEA names (France, People's Republic of China), stats codes (FRANCE, WORLD, OECDTOT, CHINAREG) or aggregate short names (EU27, OECD, IEA, World).

cursor.description: next_cursor from the previous page of the same query; maximum offset 200000.

flows.description: Stats flow codes (TES, TFC, INDPROD, IMPORTS, EXPORTS, TOTIND, TOTTRANS, RESIDENT, ...; CO2: CO2FUEL, ELECHEAT, TOTTRANS, TOTIND, RESIDENT, ...) or price sectors (RESID, IND, TRANS, COMM, ELGEN). Not for MES.

frequency.description:
Must match the dataset (annual highlights: A; monthly electricity statistics and monthly oil prices: M).

Provider reference: allowed values ["A", "M"].

indicators.description: Data-browser indicators per dataset (see `dataset`.indicators): TESbySource, TFCbySource, TFCbySector, ElecGenByFuel, ElecConsBySector, CO2BySector, CO2Intensity; prices: PRICE, PRICE CONVERTED, HEATHOUSE, COOKING, SHOWER, CARS, PRICEMONTHLY. Cannot be combined with products/flows for stats datasets.

page_size.description:
page_size

Provider reference: minimum 1; maximum 1000; default 20.

products.description: Stats product codes (TOTAL, COAL, NATGAS, ELECTR, MTOTOIL, COMRENEW, GEOTHERM, HEAT, TOTPRODS; CO2: COAL, OIL, GAS, OTHER, TOTAL), MES product names (Wind, Solar, Nuclear, Hydro, Coal, Natural gas, Net electricity production, ...) or price product codes (ELECTR, NATGAS, GASOLINE, DIESEL, LPG, KEROSENE, RESFUEL, COAL).

Catalog of IEA datasets: every free CC BY 4.0 dataset served by api.iea.org (energy balances, electricity and heat, oil, gas, CO2 from fuel combustion, monthly electricity statistics, energy prices, monthly oil prices) plus the paid and account-gated products that `data` refuses, each with its license. No network call; `last_updated` is null here and probed live by `dataset`.

<!-- aisa-pricing:end -->

cc_by: retrievable CC BY 4.0 datasets; paid: commercial and non-CC account-gated products (refused by `data`); any: both.

Provider reference: allowed values ["cc_by", "paid", "any"]; default "any".
